name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: Ancient palace fortress built atop a massive 200-meter column of rock with iconic frescoes and water gardens.

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's premier wildlife sanctuary, famous worldwide for having one of the highest leopard densities.

name: Temple of the Tooth, Kandy
description: A sacred Buddhist temple in the royal palace complex of Kandy, housing the relic of the tooth of the Buddha.

name: Galle Dutch Fort
description: A historic colonial fortress city built by the Portuguese and Dutch on the southwest coast, showcasing beautiful arches and ramparts.
